* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres
* without a unit suffix (see SKY130_NETLIST_GUIDE.md).
*
* Architecture (pseudo-differential, two identical three-stage chains):
*   stage 1 : NMOS common-source input (summing node net4/net7) with a
*             PMOS current-source load whose gate bias (net5/net11) is
*             auto-zeroed to the ibias mirror voltage each reset phase.
*   stage 2 : NMOS common-source with a PMOS load biased from net13, which
*             is auto-zeroed to bn1 each reset phase.
*   stage 3 : CMOS inverter output stage driving voutp/voutn.
*   Feedback: Cin (from the opposite input) and Cf (from own output) on each
*             summing node give vout = 0.9 - (Cin/Cf)*(vin-0.9), i.e.
*             differential closed-loop gain +Cin/Cf = +8.
*   bn1 is a live replica of the stage-1 input bias: a PMOS mirror current
*             (referenced to ibias) feeding an NMOS diode sized like the
*             stage-1 input device, so bn1 = Vgs(stage-1 input) at I1 exactly.
*   During RST high the bench shorts net4/net7/net13 to bn1 and net5/net11
*   to ibias, which charges every floating node; during amplification all
*   six terminals float on their hold/SC capacitors.
*
* Pins: vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13
*   vss/vdd  supplies (1.8 V)
*   vinp/vinn differential input, 0.9 V common mode
*   voutp/voutn differential output, 0.9 V target common mode
*   ibias    bias current input (25 uA sinks to vss)
*   bn1, net4, net5, net7, net11, net13  SC reset-network terminals

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* ---- bias reference: PMOS diode at ibias (bench sinks 25uA into it) ----
XBP  ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.5

* ---- bn1 replica of the stage-1 input bias point ----
* PMOS mirror (same size/gate bias as the stage-1 load) feeds an NMOS diode
* (same size as the stage-1 input device), so bn1 = Vgs(M1N) at I1.
XBRP bn1   ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=44
XBRN bn1   bn1   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=1.1

* ================= side P =================
* stage 1
XM1P nap net5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=44
XM1N nap net4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=1.1
* stage 2
XM2P nbp nbp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1.34
XM2N nbp nap   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.3 w=1.1
* stage 3 (output inverter)
XM3P voutp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=10
XM3N voutp nbp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=2   w=4

* SC network: input coupling from the opposite input, feedback from own output
CINP vinn net4  800f
CFP  voutp net4 100f
CH5P net5  vdd  200f

* ================= side N =================
XM1Q nan net11 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=44
XM1Q2 nan net7  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=1.1
* stage 2
XM2Q nbn nbn   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1.34
XM2Q2 nbn nan   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.3 w=1.1
* stage 3 (output inverter)
XM3Q voutn nbn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=10
XM3Q2 voutn nbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=2   w=4

CINN vinp net7  800f
CFN  voutn net7 100f
CH5N net11 vdd  200f

CH13 net13 vss 200f

RCMN voutn vcm_int 1.65k

* differential gain; the high open-loop gain supplies the static accuracy.

RFBP voutp gp 109k
RINN vinp gn 10k
RFBN voutn gn 109k

XPOLN voutn ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.8 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier.
* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres
* without a unit suffix (see SKY130_NETLIST_GUIDE.md).
*
* Two independent inverting half-chains, each a 3-stage ring closed by a
* feedback cap:
*   p-half : vg_n --> [st1] a_p --> [st2 dead-zone] b_p --> [st3] voutp
*            closed by Cfbkp (voutp -> vg_n)
*   n-half : vg_p --> [st1] a_n --> [st2 dead-zone] b_n --> [st3] voutn
*            closed by Cfbkn (voutn -> vg_p)
* Stage 1 is a differential pair; stage 2 is a two-device dead-zone stage
* (both pull-up and pull-down cut off within +/-DVdz of the stage-1 balance
* point, implemented with resistor level-shifts); stage 3 is a push-pull
* inverter.  Outside the dead zone the ring has large loop gain and slews the
* output; as vg returns to the virtual ground the stage-1 outputs re-enter the
* dead zone, stage 2 opens, and the output simply holds on the load caps.
*
* Pins: vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13
.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias generation.  The bench sinks 25 uA from ibias to vss, so ibias is a PMOS
* diode node (~0.65 V, PMOS gate bias).  nb is the NMOS gate bias (~0.78 V).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Xp_bd ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=0.5 w=10 nf=2   * 25uA
Xp_m1 nb     ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=5  nf=2   * ~12.5uA
Xn_d1 nb     nb    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=2  nf=1   * 12.5uA diode
* bn1 = 0.9 V internal reference (also exposed reset terminal)
Rdiv1 vdd bn1 90k
Rdiv2 bn1 vss 90k

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Input AC-coupling and SC feedback network (closed-loop gain 8).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Cfinp vg_p vinp  800f
Cfin  vg_n vinn  800f
Cfbkn vg_p voutn 100f
Cfbkp vg_n voutp 100f
Rb_p  vg_p bn1   20meg
Rb_n  vg_n bn1   20meg

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 1: differential pair, PMOS current-source loads (balance ~0.77 V,
* centre of the stage-2 dead zone).
*   Xn1a drives a_p from vg_n ; Xn1b drives a_n from vg_p (crossed).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Xn1a a_p vg_n  ns1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8  nf=2
Xn1b a_n vg_p  ns1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8  nf=2
Xn1t ns1 nb    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8  nf=2  * ~25uA tail
Xp1a a_p ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28 nf=2
Xp1b a_n ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28 nf=2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 2: dead-zone level-shifters + pull devices (one set per half).
*   pull-up PMOS gate  = a + s_up  (conducts only when a < lower edge)
*   pull-down NMOS gate = a - s_dn (conducts only when a > upper edge)
*   between the two edges both devices are cut off -> dead zone.  The edges
*   are set by R*I level shifts (s_up ~= 200 mV, s_dn ~= 200 mV -> window
*   [0.75,0.80] around the ~0.775 V stage-1 balance).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* b_p side: stages entirely from a_p
Rup_p  a_p gup_p 40k
Rdn_p  a_p gdn_p 40k
Xls_u_p gup_p ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1  * ~5uA up
Xls_d_p gdn_p nb    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1 * ~5uA dn
Xp_up_p b_p gup_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
Xn_dn_p b_p gdn_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
* b_n side: stages from a_n
Rup_n  a_n gup_n 40k
Rdn_n  a_n gdn_n 40k
Xls_u_n gup_n ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
Xls_d_n gdn_n nb    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
Xp_up_n b_n gup_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
Xn_dn_n b_n gdn_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 3: push-pull CMOS output inverters (dead zone [0.6,0.95] holds).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Xp3p voutp b_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=9
Xn3p voutp b_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
Xp3n voutn b_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=9
Xn3n voutn b_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reset-network terminals: auto-zero capacitor plates (float in amplify).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Caz1 net4  a_p  100f
Caz2 net7  vg_p 100f
Caz3 net13 vg_n 100f
Caz4 net5  b_p  100f
Caz5 net11 bn1  100f

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier.
* SKY130 ngspice scale=1u: numeric l and w are in micrometres (no u suffix).
*
* Three inverting stages per differential half, cross-coupled by the internal
* SC caps.  The second-stage load is tied to the *output* of that half (the
* classic ring-amplifier output-referenced current starve), which is what makes
* the loop settle cleanly into a low-power equilibrium at the output common
* mode.  Stage1 = NMOS CS, Stage2 = NMOS CS with output-referenced PMOS load,
* Stage3 = push-pull CMOS inverter.
*
* Reset / auto-zero: net4 and net7 are the summing (virtual-ground) nodes.
* During RST-high the bench shorts net4/net7/net13 to bn1 (NMOS diode bias),
* shorts net5/net11 to ibias (PMOS diode bias), and shorts both outputs to the
* 0.9 V common mode.  During RST-low the summing nodes float through the input
* (Cin) and feedback (Cf) caps and the loop amplifies the applied input step.

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* ---------------- Bias generation ----------------
* PMOS diode reference at ibias; the bench sinks 25u from ibias to vss.
XBP0 ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
* PMOS mirror feeds an NMOS diode so bn1 = NMOS gate bias level.
XBP1 bn1 ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XBN0 bn1 bn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- Stage 1: NMOS CS, PMOS current-source load ----------------
XMP1P v1p ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMN1P v1p net4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMP1N v1n ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMN1N v1n net7 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

* ---------------- Stage 2: NMOS CS, output-referenced PMOS load ----------------
XMN2P v2p v1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMP2P v2p voutp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XMN2N v2n v1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMP2N v2n voutn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=0.15 w=6 nf=2

* ---------------- Stage 3: push-pull CMOS inverter output ----------------
XMN3P voutp v2p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XMP3P voutp v2p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XMN3N voutn v2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XMP3N voutn v2n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   l=0.15 w=6 nf=2

* ---------------- Compensation (Miller, output to stage-1 output) ----------------
CN1 v1p cqn 0.5p
RN1 voutn cqn 2k
CN2 v1n cqp 0.5p
RN2 voutp cqp 2k

* ---------------- Internal SC feedback / input AC-coupling ----------------
CP_P vinp net4 2p
CP_N vinn net7 2p
CF_P voutn net4 0.25p
CF_N voutp net7 0.25p

* ---------------- Reset-network islands (float through SC caps) ----------------
CS5 net5 vss 1p
CS11 net11 vss 1p
CS13 net13 vss 1p

.ends ring_amp8

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier.
* Per output half: two-stage Miller OTA with a class-AB push-pull output.
*   Stage 1: NMOS diff pair with a weak PMOS mirror load.  The signal is
*            sensed on the mirror-DIODE side gate (M1), the reference bn1 is
*            on the mirror-OUTPUT side gate (M2).  Then d2 (mirror output)
*            and d1 (mirror diode) move in opposite directions with the
*            virtual ground: vnet4 up -> d1 down, d2 up.
*   Stage 2: class-AB output, NMOS gate on d2, PMOS gate on d1.  At balance
*            d1=d2 so both devices sit at a common low (near-threshold) level
*            with small quiescent current; on signal the two cooperate.
* Miller compensation from the output back to d2 (single inverting path).
*
* Reset alignment:
*   net4 / net7 = virtual grounds, auto-zeroed to bn1 (RST high).
*   net5 / net11 = preset through large R to ibias.
*   net13 = preset through large R to bn1.

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ bias
* PMOS diode reference (25 uA bench sink on ibias).
XMPD ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
* bn1 reference: NMOS diode + pull-up resistor, near 1.15 V so the NMOS
* input pair at the auto-zero virtual-ground level has headroom.
RBN1 vdd bn1 47k
XMNR bn1 bn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.1 w=0.42 nf=1

* mid-rail stator reference
RMID1 vdd mid 2meg
RMID2 mid vss 2meg
CMID mid vss 1p

* benign reset preset nodes
R5  net5  ibias 1meg
R11 net11 ibias 1meg
R13 net13 bn1   1meg

* ================================================================== P half
* Stage 1: NMOS diff pair + tail, weak PMOS mirror (d1 diode, d2 output).
XMNTP tpP bn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XM1P d1 net4 tpP vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XM2P d2 bn1  tpP vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XP1P d1 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.6 nf=1
XP2P d2 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.6 nf=1

* Stage 2: class-AB output.  NMOS driven from d2, PMOS driven from d1.
XMN5P voutp d2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2.4 nf=1
XMP5P voutp d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1

* Miller compensation from output to stage-1 output with nulling resistor.
RAZP ncomp d2 2k
CCMP voutp ncomp 4p

* SC input coupling and feedback caps (P half senses vinn)
CINI_P vinn net4  1.6p
CFB_P  voutp net4 200f

* ================================================================== N half
XMNNT tpN bn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XM1N e1 net7 tpN vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XM2N e2 bn1  tpN vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XP1N e1 e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.6 nf=1
XP2N e2 e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.6 nf=1

XMN5N voutn e2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2.4 nf=1
XMP5N voutn e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1

RAZN ncompn e2 2k
CCMN voutn ncompn 4p

CINI_N vinp net7  1.6p
CFB_N  voutn net7 200f

.ends ring_amp8

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier (three-stage ring amp).
* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres
* without a unit suffix (see SKY130_NETLIST_GUIDE.md).
*
* Signal chain (three inverting stages per side; the SC input caps are crossed
* and the feedback caps are same-side for overall non-inverting differential
* gain Cin/Cfb = 1.6p/0.2p = 8):
*   Stage 1: NMOS-LVT differential pair M1/M2 (gates net4/net13, auto-zeroed
*            to bn1 ~= 0.9 V), LVT tail MT (gate bn1). Fixed-gate PMOS loads
*            MPL1/MPL2 are gated by net11 (auto-zeroed to ibias, a PMOS
*            diode ~= 0.83 V). Weak RCM resistors centre the pair drains
*            d1/d2 in the stage-2 dead zone.
*   Stage 2: weak, long-L CMOS dead-zone inverters (gates d1/d2, drains
*            net7/net5); subthreshold conduction sets the equilibrium, the
*            Miller caps make this stage an integrator (ring-amp damping).
*   Stage 3: CMOS output inverters (gates net7/net5, drains voutp/voutn).
*   bn1 is the 0.9 V auto-zero reference held by an internal divider; the
*   bench only switches to bn1, it does not drive it.
*
* MOS terminal order: drain gate source bulk.
*
* Pins: vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* --- 0.9 V auto-zero reference (bn1), resistive divider + hold cap ---
RBN1 vdd  bn1 30k
RBN2 bn1  vss 30k
CBN1 bn1  vss 1p

* --- Bias: PMOS diode MPD from vdd to ibias (bench sinks 25 uA through it).
*     V(ibias) ~= 0.83 V; net11 (PMOS load gates) auto-zeros to it. ---
XMPD ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=44.0 nf=11

* --- Stage 1: NMOS-LVT differential pair + LVT tail (tail gate at bn1) ---
XMT  ts   bn1  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XM1  d1   net4 ts   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=40.0 nf=10
XM2  d2   net13 ts   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=40.0 nf=10

* --- Stage-1 PMOS loads (gates net11 = ibias) ---
XMPL1 d1  net11 vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28.0 nf=10
XMPL2 d2  net11 vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28.0 nf=10

* --- Weak drain common-mode centring ---
RCM1 d1  bn1 200k
RCM2 d2  bn1 200k

* --- Stage 2: weak long-L dead-zone CMOS inverters ---
XP1  net7 d1   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=2.0 nf=2
XN1  net7 d1   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4.0 w=1.0  nf=1
XP2  net5 d2   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=2.0 nf=2
XN2  net5 d2   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4.0 w=1.0  nf=1

* --- Stage 3: CMOS output inverters ---
XMPP voutp net7 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=20.0 nf=10
XMNP voutp net7 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=10.0 nf=5
XMPN voutn net5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=20.0 nf=10
XMNN voutn net5 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=10.0 nf=5

* --- Miller compensation (stage-2 output to stage-3 output) ---
CCP net7  voutp 0.3p
CCN net5  voutn 0.3p

* --- Hold caps on auto-zeroed floating nodes ---
CHB net11 vss 5p
CIB ibias vss 5p
CH7 net7  vss 0.1p
CH5 net5  vss 0.1p

* --- SC feedback caps (same side: voutp->net4, voutn->net13) ---
CFP voutp net4  0.2p
CFN voutn net13 0.2p

* --- SC input AC-coupling caps (crossed for non-inverting differential gain):
*     vinp -> net13 (N-side summing node), vinn -> net4 (P-side) ---
CIP vinp  net13 1.6p
CIN vinn  net4  1.6p

.ends ring_amp8

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier.
* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres
* without a unit suffix (see SKY130_NETLIST_GUIDE.md).
*
* Topology (fully differential, three signal stages):
*   Stage 1: symmetric CMOS inverter on each side (gates net4/net7); biased at
*            the inverter trip point (~0.9 V) so both devices conduct.
*   Stage 2: per side, two threshold-shifted CMOS inverters form the split
*            second stage: invHi (high trip, PMOS-strong) drives the output
*            PMOS gate (net5/net11); invLo (low trip, NMOS-strong) drives the
*            output NMOS gate (tp/tn). The trip-point gap is the dead zone:
*            a inside the gap -> both output devices off (zero static
*            current); a above/below -> only PMOS or NMOS conducts.
*   Stage 3: split push-pull output devices.
* Feedback: input is cross-coupled (vinn->gp, vinp->gn), same-side feedback
* caps (voutp->gp, voutn->gn); gain = CIN/CFB = 8.
* Bias: bn1 is a self-biased inverter node at its trip point (~0.9 V); it
* presets net4/net7/net13 during RST. ibias is a plain PMOS diode that only
* carries the 25 uA reference: it is kept out of the signal path so the RST
* short net5/net11->ibias cannot form a regenerative loop. ibias (~1.4 V)
* also leaves the output PMOS gates safely off during RST.
*
* Pins: vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* ---- Bias references -----------------------------------------------------
* Self-biased inverter: forces bn1 to its own switching trip point (~0.9).
XN0 bn1 bn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP0 bn1 bn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
* PMOS diode carries the 25 uA external reference (no signal path loading).
XMPB ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
CBI ibias vdd 200f

* ---- Stage 1: symmetric input inverters ----------------------------------
XN1 a_p net4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XP1 a_p net4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XN2 a_n net7 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XP2 a_n net7 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

* ---- Stage 2: threshold-shifted split inverters (dead zone) --------------
* p-side: invHi -> net5 (output PMOS gate), invLo -> tp (output NMOS gate).
XN5H net5 a_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XP5H net5 a_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.5 nf=1
XN5L tp a_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XP5L tp a_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
* n-side
XN11H net11 a_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XP11H net11 a_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.5 nf=1
XN11L tn a_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XP11L tn a_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1

* ---- Stage 3: split push-pull outputs -------------------------------------
XMPOP voutp net5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=20 nf=4
XMNOP voutp tp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=8 nf=4
XMPON voutn net11 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=20 nf=4
XMNON voutn tn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=8 nf=4

* ---- Dead-zone stabilization / charge-hold caps --------------------------
CS5 net5 vss 100f
CTP tp vss 100f
CS11 net11 vss 100f
CTN tn vss 100f

* ---- net13: preset to bn1 at RST, floats during amplify ------------------
C13 net13 vss 1p

* ---- SC input coupling and closed-loop feedback --------------------------
* Cross-coupled inputs (sets positive differential transfer).
CINP vinn net4 800f
CINN vinp net7 800f
* Same-side feedback; gain CIN/CFB = 8.
CFPB voutp net4 100f
CFNB voutn net7 100f

.ends ring_amp8

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier.
* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres
* without a unit suffix (see SKY130_NETLIST_GUIDE.md).
*
* Three-stage fully-differential ring amplifier with internal SC feedback.
*   bn1   = switching threshold of a self-biased (diode) reference inverter;
*           the input inverter gates net4/net7 and net13 auto-zero to it.
*   ibias = high PMOS-gate bias (PMOS diode to vdd; bench sinks 25uA).
*   Stage 1: CMOS inverters (gates net4/net7) -> vo1p/vo1n.
*   Stage 2: CMOS inverters (gates vo1) -> a2p/a2n.
*   Stage 3: dead-zone class-AB output. PMOS gates net5/net11 auto-zero to
*            ibias and are R-held high; NMOS gates gp/gn are R-held to vss;
*            both are driven from stage 2 through coupling caps.
* SC network: Cin/Cf = 1/8 -> differential gain 8; inputs crossed relative to
* outputs for non-inverting differential gain.
*
* Pins: vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* ---- Bias references ----
* High PMOS-gate bias: PMOS diode from vdd (bench sinks 25uA).
XMPd  ibias ibias vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30  nf=6
* Self-biased reference inverter sets bn1 to its switching threshold.
XMRP  bn1  bn1  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4  nf=2
XMRN  bn1  bn1  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3  w=2  nf=2
* Hold/decoupling caps.
Cibd  ibias vss  3p
Cbnd  bn1   vss  6p
Cntd  net13 vss  4p
* net13 auto-zeros to bn1; R-hold keeps it quiet (unused bias node).
RNT   net13 bn1  2meg

* ---- Stage 1: CMOS input inverters (threshold tracks bn1) ----
XM1Pp vo1p net4 vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4  nf=2
XM1Pn vo1p net4 vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3  w=2  nf=2
XM1Np vo1n net7 vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4  nf=2
XM1Nn vo1n net7 vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3  w=2  nf=2

* ---- Stage 2: CMOS inverters ----
XM2Pp a2p  vo1p vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4  nf=2
XM2Pn a2p  vo1p vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3  w=2  nf=2
XM2Np a2n  vo1n vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4  nf=2
XM2Nn a2n  vo1n vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3  w=2  nf=2

* ---- Stage 3: dead-zone class-AB output ----
XMPop voutp net5  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=20  nf=5
XMNop voutp gp    vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3  w=10  nf=5
XMPon voutn net11 vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=20  nf=5
XMNon voutn gn    vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3  w=10  nf=5
* R-holds: PMOS gates held at ibias (high/off), NMOS gates held at vss (off).
RPP net5  ibias 2meg
RPN net11 ibias 2meg
RNP gp    vss   2meg
RNN gn    vss   2meg
* Coupling caps from stage 2 to the same-side output gates: a2p drives the
* p-output PMOS gate (net5) and NMOS gate (gp); a2n drives the n-output gates.
* a2p low  -> net5 low (PMOS on, pull up),  gp low  (NMOS off).
* a2p high -> net5 high (PMOS off),         gp high (NMOS on, pull down).
CCP1 a2p  net5  2p
CCP2 a2p  gp    2p
CCN1 a2n  net11 2p
CCN2 a2n  gn    2p

* ---- SC feedback / input (gain = Cin/Cf = 8) ----
* Inverting SC gain: Vout = -(Cin/Cf)*Vin. Input caps are 8x the feedback
* caps for closed-loop gain 8; inputs are crossed to the opposite output.
Cina  vinn  net4  4p
Cinb  vinp  net7  4p
Cfa   voutp net4  0.5p
Cfb   voutn net7  0.5p

.ends ring_amp8

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier.
* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres
* without a unit suffix (see SKY130_NETLIST_GUIDE.md).
*
* Three-stage differential ringamp:
*   stage 1: NMOS differential pair with PMOS current-source loads; pair gates
*            are the SC summing nodes (net5/net11, auto-zeroed to ibias);
*            load gate net13 is sample-held at bn1.

*            (cap-coupled from the stage-1 drains, reset to bn1), NMOS gates
*            are the stage-1 drains themselves.

* differential input yields a positive differential output.

* The bench sinks 25 uA from ibias; the subcircuit sources it through
* this PMOS diode, so ibias = vdd - Vsg at 25 uA.

RBPB v1b vss 650k

C2PB net7 v1b 80f
* Chain A
XP2A v3a net4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=5
XN2A v3a v1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4

XN2B v3b v1b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4

XP3A voutp v3a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=2
XN3A voutp v3a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=2
XP3B voutn v3b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=2
XN3B voutn v3b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=2

CCMA v3a voutp 30f

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier (three-stage core).
* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres
* without a unit suffix (see SKY130_NETLIST_GUIDE.md).
*
* The bench owns the sampled-data switch network and clock; this subcircuit is
* the amplifier core plus the internal SC feedback/compensation caps and the
* input AC-coupling network. During RST-high the bench:
*   - shorts net4/net7/net13 to bn1 (the 0.9 V signal common mode),
*   - shorts net5/net11 to ibias (the PMOS gate-bias line),
*   - shorts voutp/voutn to the 0.9 V common-mode reference.
* During RST-low the gate nodes hold their precharge and the amplifier settles
* to closed-loop differential gain +8.
*
* The bench sinks 25 uA out of ibias, so ibias is sourced here by a diode PMOS
* and is the PMOS current-mirror gate bias; an internal NMOS bias nb is derived
* for the input-pair tail.
*
* Three inverting gains per channel:
*   stage 1: NMOS differential pair (gates = summing nodes net4/net7), NMOS
*            tail (gate nb), PMOS current-source loads (gates net5/net11).
*   stage 2: CMOS inverter (threshold ~0.9 V, LVT PMOS), net13/netx -> sp/sn.
*   stage 3: CMOS push-pull output inverter, crossed (sn -> voutp, sp -> voutn)
*            so the differential transfer is non-inverting; crossed feedback
*            caps close negative feedback. Dead-zone resistors Rdz plus Miller
*            compensation stabilise the three-stage ring.
* SC gain: |Vout_diff| = (Cs/Cf)|Vin_diff| = 0.4p/0.05p = 8.
*
* Pins: vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XPD  ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XPB  nb    ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XNB  nb    nb    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8  nf=2
RB1  vdd bn1 120k
RB2  bn1 vss 120k
RGP1 vdd vgp 134k
RGP2 vgp vss 100k
RGN1 vdd vgn 100k
RGN2 vgn vss 134k

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 1: NMOS differential pair.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XN1  net13 net4 tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4
XN2  netx  net7 tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4
XNT  tail  nb    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XP1  net13 net5  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=13.8 nf=2
XP2  netx  net11 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=13.8 nf=2

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 2: CMOS inverter gain (threshold ~0.9 V via LVT PMOS ratio).
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XN3  sp  net13 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=6   nf=2
XP3  sp  net13 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4.4 nf=2
XN4  sn  netx  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=6   nf=2
XP4  sn  netx  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4.4 nf=2

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 3: crossed CMOS push-pull outputs + dead-zone resistors.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
RGPP gPp vgp 8k
RGPN gPn vgn 8k
RGNP gNp vgp 8k
RGNN gNn vgn 8k
CGPP sn gPp 2p
CGPN sn gPn 2p
CGNP sp gNp 2p
CGNN sp gNn 2p
XP5  voutp gPp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4
XN5  voutp gPn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4
XP6  voutn gNp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4
XN6  voutn gNn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4
CCP  sp  net13 0.5p
CCN  sn  netx  0.5p

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Switched-capacitor network (crossed, gain Cs/Cf = 8).
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CSP  net4 vinp  0.4p
CSN  net7 vinn  0.4p
CFP  net4 voutn 0.05p

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier.
* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres
* without a unit suffix (see SKY130_NETLIST_GUIDE.md).
*
* Architecture: two cross-coupled single-ended 3-stage ring amplifiers.
* Each channel = three cascaded CMOS inverters (a "ring"); the forward path is
* inverting (3 inversions) so the capacitive feedback Cf gives a stable
* negative-feedback inverting gain of Cin/Cf.  The two channels are driven by
* opposite input phases (vinn->voutp, vinp->voutn), making the differential
* gain NON-inverting and equal to +Cin/Cf = +8.
*
* Operating point: every inverter (all 3 stages per channel + the bn1
* reference) uses the SAME device ratio so they share one trip point; the bn1
* reference is a self-biased inverter of that same ratio, so bn1 = the trip.
* During RST the bench pins each summing node to bn1 (= trip, the linear
* region) and each output to 0.9 V.  On release the high loop gain holds the
* summing node ~bn1 and the cap feedback sets vout = ((Cin+Cf)/Cf)*0.9 -
* (Cin/Cf)*vin  (the bn1 reference cancels), so the differential output is
* centred on 0.9 V with gain 8.
*
* Pins: vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13
*   net4/net7  summing nodes of channel P / N (reset to bn1 during RST).
*   net5/net11/net13  spare reset ports, bonded to ibias/bn1 references.

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* --- bias/reference generation -----------------------------------------
* bn1: self-biased inverter of the SAME ratio as the gain stages -> bn1 = trip.
XMPref bn1 bn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2
XMNref bn1 bn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=1

* ibias: PMOS diode gives the bench's 25 uA sink a defined path.
XMDiod ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2

* bond spare reset-network ports to their references (never floating).
Rn5  net5  ibias 1
Rn11 net11 ibias 1
Rn13 net13 bn1  1

* ================= Channel P : output voutp, input vinn =================
* stage 1 - summing inverter (gate = net4)
XMP1p a1p net4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2
XMN1p a1p net4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=1
* stage 2
XMP2p a2p a1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2
XMN2p a2p a1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=1
* stage 3 - output inverter, nf-scaled for 10 pF drive (same ratio -> same trip)
XMP3p voutp a2p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=4
XMN3p voutp a2p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=4 nf=4
* SC feedback / input coupling: gain = Cin/Cf = 2p/0.25p = 8
CinP vinn net4  2p
CfP  voutp net4 0.25p
* nested-Miller compensation (stage1out->out, stage2out->out)
Cc1p a1p voutp 0.4p
Cc2p a2p voutp 0.4p

* ================= Channel N : output voutn, input vinp =================
XMP1n a1n net7 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2
XMN1n a1n net7 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=1
XMP2n a2n a1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2
XMN2n a2n a1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=1
XMP3n voutn a2n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=4
XMN3n voutn a2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=4 nf=4
CinN vinp net7  2p
CfN  voutn net7 0.25p
Cc1n a1n voutn 0.4p
Cc2n a2n voutn 0.4p

.ends ring_amp8

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier.
* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres
* without a unit suffix (see SKY130_NETLIST_GUIDE.md).
*
* Fully differential three-stage ring amplifier:
*   stage 1: two CMOS inverters, floating gates net4/net7 (auto-zero nodes)
*   deadzone resistors connect stage-1 outputs to stage-2 gates
*   stage 2: two CMOS inverters, floating gates net13/net5
*   stage 3: two CMOS output inverters driving voutp/voutn (10 pF loads)
* Internal SC network:
*   input AC-coupling caps CIN (input swapped across halves so the three
*   inverting stages give non-inverting differential gain)
*   same-side feedback caps CFB: gain CIN/CFB = 8
*   compensation caps CC between stage-2 gates and outputs
* Bias generator:
*   25 uA sunk from ibias flows through a diode PMOS (Vibias ~= 0.9 V); a 1:1
*   PMOS mirror feeds a self-biased reference inverter whose gate/drain is
*   bn1, so bn1 equals the exact switching threshold of the identical
*   stage-1 inverters (~0.89 V). Every floating gate is precharged to bias.
*
* Pins: vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* ---- Bias generator ----
XMPD ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.6
XMPM bn1   ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.6
XREF_N bn1 bn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XREF_P bn1 bn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.6

* ---- Stage 1: input inverters (gates net4 = g1p, net7 = g1n) ----
XM1P_D a1p net4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XM1P_U a1p net4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.6
XM1N_D a1n net7 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XM1N_U a1n net7 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.6

* ---- Deadzone resistors ----
RP_DZ a1p net13 100k
RN_DZ a1n net5  100k

* ---- Stage 2: inverters (gates net13 = g2p, net5 = g2n) ----
XM2P_D a2p net13 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XM2P_U a2p net13 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7.8
XM2N_D a2n net5  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XM2N_U a2n net5  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7.8

* ---- Stage 3: output inverters ----
XM3P_D voutp a2p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XM3P_U voutp a2p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7.8
XM3N_D voutn a2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XM3N_U voutn a2n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7.8

* ---- Input AC-coupling caps (8x); inputs swapped for non-inverting gain ----
CINP vinn net4 800f
CINN vinp net7 800f

* ---- Same-side feedback caps (1x): gain = CIN/CFB = 8 ----
CFBP net4 voutp 100f
CFBN net7 voutn 100f

* ---- Compensation caps (stage-2 gate to output) ----
CCP net13 voutp 200f
CCN net5  voutn 200f

* ---- net11: spare SC reset node, precharged to V(ibias) ----
CD11 net11 vss 100f

.ends ring_amp8

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier.
* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres
* without a unit suffix (see SKY130_NETLIST_GUIDE.md).
*
* Three-stage fully-differential amplifier with SC feedback (gain=Cin/Cf=8).
*   stage1 : NMOS-input diff pair, PMOS mirror load  (inverting, high gain)
*   stage2 : PMOS common-source, NMOS diode load     (inverting, level-shift)
*   stage3 : NMOS common-source output, PMOS CMFB load (inverting)
* Three inversions -> inverting forward path; capacitive feedback closes a
* negative-feedback loop.  Output CM held at 0.9 V by an SC CMFB (net7 samples
* the output CM via Ccm and drives the stage3 PMOS-load gates).
*
* Pins: vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13
*   net4/net13 = summing nodes (stage1 inputs)
*   net7       = SC CMFB control (stage3 PMOS-load gates)
*   net5/net11 = bias bypass hold caps (charged to ibias during reset)
*   bn1        = auto-zero/CM reference (0.9 V, tied to input CM during reset)

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

*--- reference: bn1 = input common mode (0.9 V during reset, low-Z) ----------
RRref bn1 vinn 1

*--- bias: 25 uA into ibias -> Vbp (PFET) and Vbn (NMOS) references -----------
XMPbias ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMPbn   vbn   ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMNbn   vbn   vbn   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

*==================== stage1: NMOS-input diff pair ========================
XMN1p  a1p net4  t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=1
XMN1n  a1n net13 t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=1
XMNt1  t1  vbn   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=1
XMP1d  a1n a1n   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1
XMP1m  a1p a1n   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1

*==================== stage2: PMOS common-source, NMOS diode load =========
XMP2p  a2p a1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XMP2n  a2n a1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XMN2Lp a2p a2p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1
XMN2Ln a2n a2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1

*==================== stage3: NMOS output + PMOS (CMFB) load ===============
XMN3p  voutp a2p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMN3n  voutn a2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMP3Lp voutp net7 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMP3Ln voutn net7 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

*--- Miller compensation across output stage (1 inversion = neg Miller) ---
CCm_p voutp a2p 0.3p
CCm_n voutn a2n 0.3p

*--- switched-capacitor feedback, gain = Cin/Cf = 8 ----------------------
CCin_p vinp net13 2p
CCin_n vinn net4 2p
CCf_p voutp net4 0.25p
CCf_n voutn net13 0.25p

*--- SC CMFB: net7 samples output CM, drives stage3 PMOS loads -----------
CCcm_p voutp net7 1p
CCcm_n voutn net7 1p

*--- bias bypass hold caps on net5/net11 (charged to ibias during reset) -
CCbp5  net5  vss 1p
CCbp11 net11 vss 1p

.ends ring_amp8

circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier -- candidate v1
* Three inverting stages, closed through an internal SC feedback divider.
* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres.

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* ---- input AC coupling caps -------------------------------------------
* The bench drives vinp/vinn as a differential step around 0.9 V. These caps
* pass the step into the first stage input nodes (na/na2) and give the stage a
* defined dc operating point through the reset network.
CINP vinp na 1p
CINN vinn na2 1p

circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier (3 inverting stages).
* SKY130 ngspice libraries set scale=1u: l and w are numeric micrometres.
* NOTE: in this PDK wrapper nf does not scale width (w is total width);
* parallel fingers are expressed with the instance multiplier m=...
*
* Topology
*   Three fully-differential inverting NFET stages, PFET (lvt) current-source
*   loads, NFET tail current sources. The SC network (CS=820f from the inputs,
*   CF=100f crossed from the outputs) closes negative feedback around the
*   3-inversion chain. CS/CF = 8.2 deliberately over-ratios the ideal gain so
*   that the finite-DC-gain error cancels it:
*      gain = (CS/CF)/(1+(1+CS/CF)/A0) ~= 8.0   with A0 ~= 300-400.
*
*   Bias: PREF (pfet diode) sources the bench 25uA sink plus MREF's current;
*   during reset net5/net11 sample v(ibias) and hold it on the PFET-load and
*   tail gates during amplification. Tails are generously oversized so the
*   pair current is set by the PFET loads and the tail nodes stay low.
*
*   CM / auto-zero: bn1 is a replica built from the same devices as one side
*   of stage 1, so it sits at the stage-1 trip point. During reset the bench
*   shorts net4/net7/net13 to bn1 and the outputs to 0.9V, storing the exact
*   charge that corresponds to zero differential input and 0.9V output CM.
*   During amplification net13 (caps from both outputs) tracks the output CM
*   and drives the stage-1 PFET gates: continuous-time CM feedback.
*
*   Compensation: nested Miller. CM1 (250f) around stages 2+3 sets the loop
*   bandwidth (wu ~= beta*gm1/CM1); CM2 (500f) around the inverting stage 3
*   splits the s2/output poles; R1/R2 are differential damping resistors that
*   lower the s1/s2 node impedances so the NMC complex pole pair is well
*   damped while A0 still meets the (trim-relaxed) gain-accuracy spec.
*
* Pins: vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

CS1 vinp net4 820f
CS2 vinn net7 820f
CF1 voutn net4 100f
CF2 voutp net7 100f
* Common-mode sense caps onto net13
CCM1 voutp net13 300f
CCM2 voutn net13 300f

* --- Nested-Miller compensation ----------------------------------------------
CM1A s1n voutn 250f
CM1B s1p voutp 250f
CM2A s2n voutn 500f
CM2B s2p voutp 500f

* --- Differential damping ------------------------------------------------------
R1A s1n s1p 40k
R2A s2n s2p 100k

* --- Tail discharge paths (define tail-node DC level, prevent start-up latch)
RT1 t1 vss 2meg
RT2 t2 vss 2meg
RT3 t3 vss 2meg
RTR tr vss 2meg

* --- Stage 1 (~25 uA per side) -----------------------------------------------
XM1A s1n net4 t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 m=4
XM1B s1p net7 t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 m=4
XP1A s1n net13 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=1.5 nf=1
XP1B s1p net13 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=1.5 nf=1
XT1 t1 net11 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 m=4

* --- Stage 2 (~14 uA per side) -----------------------------------------------
XM2A s2n s1n t2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.6 m=2
XM2B s2p s1p t2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.6 m=2

XT2 t2 net11 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=3 m=4

* --- Stage 3 (~42 uA per side) -----------------------------------------------
XM3A voutn s2n t3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6.25 m=15
XM3B voutp s2p t3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6.25 m=15

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier (V5.1).
* SKY130 ngspice libraries set scale=1u: l/w are numeric micrometres.
*
* Single-stage fully-differential telescopic-cascode OTA:
*   NMOS input pair (gates = SC storage nodes net4/net7) -> NMOS cascodes
*   (gates on xbn) -> outputs; LVT-PMOS current-source loads gated from xbn.
* Branch currents are bias-defined (tail = cascode = load), so the output
* CM has no free continuum: any load/tail mismatch is trimmed by the huge
* CM loop gain through gp. Slew is Itail/2 per output into 10pF.
* Bias: LVT-PMOS diode at ibias (bench sinks 25uA) near 1.18V. PMOS mirror
* of ibias feeds an NMOS diode (xbn, ~1.04V) used for the tail sink and the
* cascode/load gates. Strong keeper pre-biases the bn1/net13/net4/net7
* auto-zero cluster to ~0.99V within the 50ns reset phase.

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* --- Bias generator: LVT PMOS diode at ibias (bench sinks 25 uA).
XMB ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

* --- Internal NMOS gate rail: PMOS mirror of ibias feeding an NMOS diode.
XMA xbn ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMBN xbn xbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.72

* --- Auto-zero cluster keeper: sets bn1 ~0.77V, the pair's equilibrium gate
* voltage (where I_pair = I_load), so the CM servo starts balanced; strong
* enough to charge bn1/net13/net4/net7 within the 50ns reset phase.
XMBK net13 ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4
XMR net13 net13 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5
CBN bn1 vss 300f

* --- Telescopic cascode gain stage. Loads sized just below Itail/2 so the
* pair is never tail-limited (keeps the CM servo negative).
XMT tail xbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7.8
XM1 c1p net4 tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1
XM2 c1n net7 tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1
XMC1P voutp xbn c1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XMC1N voutn xbn c1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XMLP1 voutp xbn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1.55
XMLP2 voutn xbn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1.55

* --- SC input coupling (crossed) and capacitive feedback divider.
CINP vinn net4 1.6p
CINN vinp net7 1.6p
CFBP voutp net4 200f
CFBN voutn net7 200f

.ends ring_amp8

taskTitle: Design a Three-Stage Closed-Loop Gain-8 Switched-Capacitor Ring Amplifier
circuit:
* Closed-loop gain-8 switched-capacitor ring amplifier.
* SKY130 ngspice model libraries set scale=1u, so l and w are in micrometres
* without a unit suffix (see SKY130_NETLIST_GUIDE.md).
*
* Architecture (pseudo-differential, one identical loop per output):
*   Three-stage amplifier per side: NMOS common-source gain stages loaded by
*   PMOS current sources whose gates all hang on the ibias diode potential
*   (current mirroring by W/L ratio). The input sampling caps are crossed
*   (p-side sums vinn, n-side sums vinp) so the closed-loop transfer is
*   NON-inverting with gain Ci/Cf = 960f/120f = 8. Rf from each output to its
*   summing node is the DC servo (output DC level = chain equilibrium ~0.9V).
*
*   Compensation: Miller capacitor Cc with series resistor Rz from the output
*   back around the output stage (node n2) - single local inversion, stable.
*
*   Reset/auto-zero: during RST high the bench shorts net4/net7/net13 to bn1
*   and net5/net11 to ibias, and forces both outputs to 0.9 V.
*     net4/net13 are the summing nodes, bn1 is driven by an internal
*     unity-gain buffer whose input is vinp (0.9 V during reset), net7 holds
*     the sampled reset potential, and net5/net11 sample the ibias diode
*     potential onto hold capacitors to bias the reset buffer.
*
* Pins: vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

.subckt ring_amp8 vss vdd vinp vinn voutp voutn ibias bn1 net4 net5 net7 net11 net13

* ----------------------- bias reference (PMOS diode) -----------------------
* The bench sinks 25 uA from ibias; the PMOS diode sources it. The diode
* potential mirrors to every PMOS load gate below (ratio = W/L ratio).
XMBD ibias ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.52 nf=3

* ========================= p-side signal path ===============================
* Summing node = net4. Crossed input cap -> non-inverting gain +8.
Ci_p vinn net4 960f
Cf_p voutp net4 120f
Rf_p voutp net4 2g

* Stage 1: NMOS CS, gate = summing node (0.9 V), PMOS current-source load.
XM1p_n n1p net4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.6 w=0.42 nf=1
XM1p_p n1p ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.13 w=0.84 nf=1

* Stage 2: NMOS CS with PMOS current-source load (two parallel load fingers
* for 2x the stage-1 mirror ratio).
XM2p_n1 n2p n1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.68 nf=2
XM2p_n2 n2p n1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.68 nf=2
XM2p_n3 n2p n1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.68 nf=2
XM2p_p1 n2p ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.68 nf=2
XM2p_p2 n2p ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.68 nf=2

* Stage 3: NMOS driver pair (moderate inversion) + PMOS current-source load.
XM3p_n1 voutp n2p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XM3p_n2 voutp n2p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XM3p_p voutp ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=3.36 nf=4

* Miller compensation with series damping resistor around the output stage.
Rz_p voutp czp 15k
Cc_p czp n2p 4.7p

* ========================= n-side signal path ===============================
Ci_n vinp net13 960f
Cf_n voutn net13 120f
Rf_n voutn net13 2g

XM1n_n n1n net13 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.6 w=0.42 nf=1
XM1n_p n1n ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.13 w=0.84 nf=1

XM2n_n1 n2n n1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.68 nf=2
XM2n_n2 n2n n1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.68 nf=2
XM2n_n3 n2n n1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=1.68 nf=2
XM2n_p1 n2n ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.68 nf=2
XM2n_p2 n2n ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.68 nf=2

XM3n_n1 voutn n2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XM3n_n2 voutn n2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XM3n_p voutn ibias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=3.36 nf=4

Rz_n voutn czn 15k
Cc_n czn n2n 4.7p

* ------------------------------ reset hub ----------------------------------
C7 net7 vss 200f

* Unity-gain buffer driving bn1: NMOS differential pair with PMOS mirror
* load (single-ended output at nb2), PMOS common-source second stage with a
* resistor pull-down to vss, Miller-compensated (Ccb around stage 2).
* Sign check: bn1 up -> XMBa up -> nb1d down, nb2 up -> XMB2 off -> nb3/bn1
* down (negative feedback); the follower output therefore tracks vinp, which
* is 0.9 V during reset.
RTAIL nbt vss 3.9k
XMBa nb1d bn1 nbt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.52 nf=3
XMBb nb2 vinp nbt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.52 nf=3
XMBLa nb1d nb1d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.68 nf=2
XMBLb nb2 nb1d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.68 nf=2
XMB2 nb3 nb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.68 nf=2
RLOAD nb3 vss 62k
Ccb nb2 nb3 1p
Rb nb3 bn1 200
* Boot capacitor: the vdd step at t=0 (uic start) kicks bn1 to ~0.9 V so the
* very first auto-zero phase starts near the correct hub potential.
Cboot bn1 vdd 2.7p

* Bias hold capacitors (sampled from the ibias diode during RST high).
C5 net5 vss 100f
C11 net11 vss 100f

.ends ring_amp8
